issuerTreatment: Issuer operating sale-and-leaseback recognition depends on fair value, selling price and lease classification. Fair-value sale gain/loss recognized in period; above-fair-value difference deferred over expected lease payments; below-fair-value losses can be deferred only under issuer policy conditions. Aircraft sale revenue follows disclosed risks/rewards and revenue recognition conditions.
canonicalTreatment: Retain net accounting revenue code10 and consolidated profit code60 as reported. Do not treat all aircraft cash sale receipts as operating revenue; no reconstructed gains, debt, or future lease liability.
